title: Cloud FinOps Analyst
summary: A cloud FinOps analyst (FinOps means cloud financial operations) tracks what a company spends on AWS, Azure or Google Cloud, explains where the money goes and finds ways to spend less. They sit between finance and engineering, often in a cloud platform or central IT team.
dailyDuties: Review daily cloud spend and flag unusual jumps
Build monthly cost reports for each team or product
Check that resources follow the tagging rules
Track reservation and savings plan coverage and suggest purchases
Find idle or oversized resources and agree fixes with engineers
Update the cloud budget forecast and explain variances to finance

skills.expectation: Find savings and track cloud spend against targets
Analyse cost data in Cost Explorer, Azure Cost Management or a FinOps tool
Know the pricing of at least one major cloud
Know the pricing of at least one major cloud
Know the pricing of at least one major cloud
Set tagging rules and report costs back to each team
Plan reservations and savings plans and track their use
Query billing exports and cost and usage reports
Forecast cloud spend and explain budget variances
Build cost models and reports in spreadsheets
Agree savings actions with engineering and finance teams
Automate cost reports and clean-up checks
Query billing exports in BigQuery or similar

groups.label: A cloud platform (AWS, Azure or GCP)

certifications.why: Azure pricing and cost management basics
Preferred in most FinOps postings and has no prerequisites.
